description: Source code implementing PHY management and switch configuration functions for Realtek RTL8366 series switches, including MII register access, GPIO-based SMI communication, and switch feature controls.

methods.name: smi_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO-based SMI interface by setting SDA and SCK lines to input and setting initial states.

methods.name: smi_start
methods.description: Generates a start condition on the SMI interface, including an extra clock cycle with SDA high.

methods.name: smi_stop
methods.description: Generates a stop condition on the SMI interface, including an extra clock cycle with SDA high.

methods.name: smi_writeBits
methods.description: Writes a specified number of bits to the SMI interface.

methods.name: smi_readBits
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bits from the SMI interface.

methods.name: smi_waitAck
methods.description: Waits for acknowledgment from the switch via SMI.

methods.name: smi_read
methods.description: Reads a register value from the switch via SMI.

methods.name: smi_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register in the switch via SMI.

methods.name: rtl8366_readRegister
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the switch.

methods.name: rtl8366_writeRegister
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register in the switch.

methods.name: rtl8366_setRegisterBit
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific bit in a register.

methods.name: rtl8366_getPhyReg
methods.description: Reads a PHY register via switch's MDIO interface.

methods.name: rtl8366_setPhyReg
methods.description: Writes to a PHY register via switch's MDIO interface.

methods.name: rtl8366_miiread
methods.description: External interface function to read PHY register, registered with miiphy.

methods.name: rtl8366_miiwrite
methods.description: External interface function to write PHY register, registered with miiphy.

methods.name: rtl8366_mii_register
methods.description: Registers the MII interface functions with the system.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setGreenFeature
methods.description: Enables or disables green feature on the switch.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setPowerSaving
methods.description: Enables or disables power saving mode on a PHY port.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setGreenEthernet
methods.description: Configures green Ethernet features based on switch model.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setCPUPortMask
methods.description: Sets CPU port mask for a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setCPUDisableInsTag
methods.description: Enables or disables insertion of instruction tags on CPU port.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setCPUDropUnda
methods.description: Enables or disables dropping of untagged packets on CPU port.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setCPUPort
methods.description: Configures CPU port settings including noTag and dropUnda options.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setLedConfig
methods.description: Sets LED configuration for a specific LED group.

methods.name: rtl8366s_getLedConfig
methods.description: Gets LED configuration for a specific LED group.

methods.name: rtl8366s_setLedForceValue
methods.description: Forces LED states for groups 0-3.

methods.name: rtl8366s_initChip
methods.description: Initializes the switch chip with default settings and configurations.

methods.name: rtl8366s_initialize
methods.description: Performs overall initialization of the switch including SMI setup and basic configuration.
